heading: What Is Artistic Western Photography?
subtitles: Definition: Artistic Western photography interprets the American West through authorship, atmosphere, and visual intent rather than simple documentation. The camera records the scene. The artist decides what the scene becomes.

bridge.title: Artistic Western photography begins where record becomes interpretation.
bridge.intro: Landscape, frontier tension, black-and-white restraint, and cultural portraiture become more than Western subject matter when light, tone, composition, and mood are shaped with intent.
